title: Empowering Attack - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Empowering Attack in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Spring Meadows - Indigo Tree Flag, ledge near the exit portal

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Empowering Attack is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Base Attacks grant Powerful.

sections.title: How to Get Empowering Attack
sections.content: Location: Spring Meadows - Indigo Tree Flag, ledge near the exit portal.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
